rejected_or_not_implemented.reason: Qwen RESEARCH LICENSE = 'FOR NON-COMMERCIAL PURPOSES ONLY' (commercial use requires a separate license from Alibaba Cloud). Not usable for a commercial product. The 7B (Apache-2.0) is selected instead.

NOT in approved product scope. Spec G2_G3 §4.3 defines Visual Search as 'Vision AI Attribute Extraction' + attribute-tagged ranking (current impl: Gemini -> attributes -> keyword/facet scoring). There is NO perceptual/CLIP vector-retrieval feature in the specs. Building it would be an unused embedding model (explicitly prohibited). License NOT VERIFIED.
No standalone fashion-object-detection feature exists. (YOLOX runs inside the VTON worker, not as a product feature.) License NOT VERIFIED.
No standalone pose-estimation feature. Pose is internal to VTON (DWPose) and test/QA (MediaPipe). License NOT VERIFIED.

The production VTON is DIFFUSION, segmentation-FREE by design (Option A', proven on real GPU). No interactive-segmentation / image-editing feature is in the approved spec. Adding SAM2 contradicts the current architecture. License NOT VERIFIED.
No brand/logo/label-recognition or text-extraction feature in the approved specs.
No geometric/depth-aware feature in the approved specs.

rejected_or_not_implemented.reason: No uploaded-image safety-moderation feature in the specs; validation is PIL format/dimension only. Would be a P2 safety add only if product policy requires it.

G1 'biometric' = Fernet-AES-256 encrypted ANTHROPOMETRIC measurements, NOT face-embedding/identity-verification. VTON identity PRESERVATION is a model property, not a verification feature. No identity-verification feature exists.
Redundant (the segmentation-free fork is already production) AND reintroduces the non-commercial human-parser. No benefit; license/architecture risk.
No image-to-video / animated-try-on feature in the approved specs (KLING key + stub endpoint are code artifacts, not spec-backed scope). Not a self-hosted HF model (Kling is a commercial API).

rejected_or_not_implemented.reason: The AI Stylist already has a deterministic grounded StylingEngine fallback (honest, real products) for LLM exhaustion. A local LLM is an optional P2 enhancement, not a required model, and is not in the candidate set.

notes: Stylist voice/speech-to-text (spec G2_G3 §2.2) is a BROWSER-native capability (Web Speech API), currently a 'simulation'; it does NOT require a self-hosted server model. Tracked here so it is not forgotten, but it is not a local-model program item.

No vector DB / embeddings / reranker exist in the codebase (confirmed). Perceptual retrieval would require building the FULL chain (ingest -> embed -> pgvector -> NN -> filter -> rank -> API -> FE) — only if the product explicitly approves that upgrade.
One model = one branch. Program-level files (this registry + the program report) are NOT model branches; commit them to main as documentation.
